references.title: Sum of Squares Lower Bounds for Refuting Any CSP
references.note: Gives degree lower bounds for SoS refutation of random CSPs supporting uniform satisfying distributions and consequences for polynomial-size SDP relaxations.

references.title: Extended Formulation Lower Bounds for Refuting Random CSPs
references.note: Uses pseudocalibration to prove subexponential LP extended-formulation lower bounds for random CSP refutation, motivating local-gadget and planted/null attacks.

references.title: A Nearly Tight Sum-of-Squares Lower Bound for the Planted Clique Problem
references.note: Introduces pseudo-calibration as a systematic method for constructing pseudo-distributions and SoS lower-bound witnesses.

references.title: On the Bit Complexity of Sum-of-Squares Proofs
references.note: Shows that low-degree SoS proofs need not have polynomial coefficient bit complexity and gives sufficient conditions for positive bounds.

references.title: Sum-of-Squares Lower Bounds for Independent Set in Ultra-Sparse Random Graphs
references.note: Proves higher-degree SoS lower bounds for independent set in ultra-sparse random graphs and develops pseudo-calibration tools without asymptotically lossy factors.

claim_boundary: These sources motivate attacks and known barriers; they do not prove JANUS descendants.
